title: Pro Shop Store Credit: deposit-hold and large-top-up review terms by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Pro Shop Store Credit product line's deposit-hold and large-top-up review facet across every tier: the days a top-up is held before becoming spendable, the top-up amount above which a fraud-review hold applies, the days a large top-up is held for that review, and the notice required before a fee or rate increase takes effect.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Days a top-up is held before it is spendable | Top-up amount that triggers a review hold | Days a large top-up is held for review | Notice required before a fee or rate increase |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Credit $50 Tier | 0 days | 150.00 USD | 1 day | 30 days |
| Standard Credit $100 Tier | 0 days | 250.00 USD | 1 day | 30 days |
| Value Credit $250 Tier | 0 days | 400.00 USD | 2 days | 30 days |
| VIP Credit $500 Tier | 0 days | 750.00 USD | 2 days | 45 days |
| Auto-Reload Standard | 0 days | 250.00 USD | 1 day | 30 days |
| Auto-Reload Premium | 0 days | 400.00 USD | 1 day | 30 days |

## Points of reference
- No tier of this product currently holds an ordinary top-up before it becomes spendable; the deposit-hold figure shown is zero across every tier.
- The top-up amount that triggers a review hold rises with the tier's own standard top-up amount, and the VIP Credit $500 Tier alone requires 45 days' notice before a fee or rate increase, longer than the 30 days required on every other tier.

## Basis Q&A
**Which tier requires the longest notice before a fee or rate increase takes effect?** The VIP Credit $500 Tier, at 45 days.
**Do the Value Credit $250 Tier and Auto-Reload Premium share the same large-top-up review-hold length?** No — the Value Credit $250 Tier holds a large top-up for 2 days, while Auto-Reload Premium holds it for 1 day.
